comment.zh-CN: 主因是浓雾／低云。美国模式在 10/26 至 10/31 多个时段报能见度仅 56 至 349 米，例如 10/31 08–20 时为 56 米；但它是唯一提供能见度的模式，也没有机场预报可佐证。风雨方面，各模式阵风最高 17.7 节，阵风超过 29 节的概率均为 0%，6 小时雨量最多 7.1 毫米，因此停飞风险评为中。
comment.en: The main cause is fog/low cloud. The US model shows visibility of only 56 to 349 m in several periods from 10/26 to 10/31, for example 56 m on 10/31 08:00-20:00; however, it is the only model providing visibility, and there is no airport forecast (TAF) to confirm it. On wind and rain, the highest gust across models is 17.7 kt, the chance of gusts over 29 kt is 0% throughout, and rain peaks at 7.1 mm in 6 hours, so the disruption risk is rated Medium.

comment.zh-CN: 未来五天停飞风险为中，主因是浓雾／低云。无机场观测与机场预报数据。美国模式在 10/26 20 时–10/27 02 时、10/27 08 时–10/28 02 时、10/28 08 时–10/29 02 时、10/30 08–20 时及 10/31 08–20 时预测能见度仅 56 至 349 米，使浓雾风险达中。风雨方面，各模式阵风与估算阵风最高仅 17.7 节、6 小时雨量最多 7.1 毫米，欧洲系集阵风超过 29 节的概率 0%，风雨风险皆为低。
comment.en: The disruption risk over the next five days is Medium, mainly due to dense fog and low clouds. No airport observation or airport forecast (TAF) data is available. The US model predicts visibility of only 56 to 349 m during 10/26 20:00–10/27 02:00, 10/27 08:00–10/28 02:00, 10/28 08:00–10/29 02:00, 10/30 08:00–20:00, and 10/31 08:00–20:00, raising the fog risk to Medium. For wind and rain, gusts and estimated gusts across models peak at just 17.7 kt, 6-hour rainfall reaches at most 7.1 mm, and the European ensemble shows a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt, keeping wind and rain risks Low.
